description: This Java class 'ClientFamilyMembersReadPlatformServiceImpl' implements functionality to read client family member data from a database. It includes methods for retrieving lists of family members, individual family member details, and available options for related attributes such as marital status, gender, relationship, and profession. It uses Spring's JdbcTemplate for database operations and relies on other service components for code values.

classes.name: ClientFamilyMembersMapper
classes.description: A private static class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to ClientFamilyMembersData objects.

methods.name: getClientFamilyMembers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of family members associated with a specific client ID from the database.

methods.name: getClientFamilyMember
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific family member by their unique ID.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides default template data including options for relationship, gender, marital status, and profession.
